exclusions.source_text: Patients 1 - 30 years of age at the time of enrollment are eligible for this study.
Patients must demonstrate adequate performance level as measured by Karnofsky ≥ 70% for patients aged 16 years or older, OR Lansky ≥ 70% for patients younger than 16 years.
Total bilirubin ≤ 1.5 x ULN for age\*
ALT ≤ 3.0 x ULN for age (≤ 135 U/L). For the purpose of this study, the ULN for ALT is 45 U/L
Pregnant or currently breast feeding: Pregnant participants are excluded from this study because protocol therapy has the potential for teratogenic or abortifacient effects.
Untreated central nervous system (CNS) metastatic disease
Clinically significant arrhythmias, i.e. those that cause clinical symptoms or require medications for control of symptoms
